annotatedSteps.description: Explanation of inheritance and genetic cross
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
(a) Free earlobe (F) is dominant, attached earlobe (f) is recessive.
Man (attached) is ff. Woman (free) must be Ff because half the children are attached.
Parents: Ff x ff
Gametes: F, f   f, f
F1: Ff, Ff, ff, ff
